name: Miracle No-ton
source:
Protagonist Ogata Akira finds a magical living notebook that can grant any wish he writes in it.  But there’s a catch: only horny wishes work.  So begins Akira’s days of homoerotic wish writing….

[From [url=http://sandeian.wordpress.com/2010/05/26/bl-game-review-miracle-noton/]4shiki[/url]]
